name: VoxBot
tagline: Puts real calls through your own telephony and voice accounts
description: Runs real phone calls through telephony and voice accounts you connect yourself. Outbound calls are placed on request against a scripted brief, inbound callers face an authentication gate once you set one, and you choose which voice answers. Spend and numbers stay on your own accounts.
author: andrewslaptop
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
